blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why only names accountants copying invoices into their spreadsheet ("Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month."); a CSV route answers it. Nothing asks for PDF, XLSX, XML or JSON. Drop the plugin system from the proposal, replace design.md's "Decision: Exports go through a plugin registry" by a single CSV renderer (the alternative design.md rejects only as "not extensible", which the Why never requires), and remove task 1.2 ("Plugin registry discovering `src/export/plugins/`, verified by `npm test -- registry`"). Start-up discovery of modules in a TypeScript project built with `tsc` is also an unverified assumption the plan would no longer need. Propose the registry in its own change when a second format is actually requested.
findings.title: Plugin system for future export formats is scope nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: The Why asks for a monthly export, not a per-user preference; with CSV as the only format, the choice has a single option. Remove this requirement, its scenarios, the proposal line "A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format.", the sentence "A settings page stores each user's preferred format." in design.md, `web/src/settings/` from Impact, and task 2.1. As written the requirement is also unverifiable: scenario "A preference" says "exports use CSV" while the only route is the fixed `/invoices.csv`, so no observable behavior depends on the preference, and no requirement says where the preference is stored.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format is scope nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: The change exposes a new route, `GET /invoices.csv?month=YYYY-MM`, that returns every invoice of a month with its customer name and total, yet no domain is ticked, so no expert reviews who may call it or what customer data leaves the system; the spec has no unauthorized-caller scenario either. Tick `security` and `personal-data`, or give the reason on each line. If the settings page stays despite R-skeptic-2, `user-interface` must be ticked too, since `web/src/settings/` is in Impact.
findings.title: Invoice export endpoint touches security and personal data with every domain unticked
